title: Admiral Ackbar
franchise: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
description: During the Clone Wars, Gial Ackbar led the defense of his planet, Mon Cala, against the predations of the Separatist-aligned Quarren. When the Empire took over the galaxy, he became an Admiral in the Alliance to Restore the Republic and planned the attack against the second Death Star over the Forest moon of Endor. Unfortunately, he realized too late that they had been drawn into Palpatine's trap.
